description:
A rough, irresistible romance story of three men with no respect for each other’s boundaries.  

Eejae Lee and Jingi Shin are two men who have a history of breaking up and getting back together repeatedly. Eejae starts living with Jingi, who is in a contract marriage, but remembers how Jingi was the one to end the relationship, claiming he wasn’t gay.  

Meanwhile, Cheok Lee, the new, charismatic director of Soul Brush, appears in front of Eejae, the current manager. What lies in store for the three men caught in a love triangle?

**Original Webtoon:**  
R19: [Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/what_a_partner), [RIDI](https://ridibooks.com/books/297009042), [KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/content/65341827), [Bomtoon](https://www.bomtoon.com/detail/bye_n_hi), [MrBlue](https://www.mrblue.com/comic/dw_0776)  
R15: [KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/content/51102729), [MrBlue](https://www.mrblue.com/comic/dw_1269)
